cases.name: completed_page_with_mixed_item_changes
cases.situation: A completed page has a modified loading state, a removed open-details behavior, an added retry behavior, and unchanged accepted work.
cases.baseline_observation: The old skill stores only page status and acceptance metadata. It has no accepted state or behavior contracts, independent item statuses, removed-task records, or changes command, so it cannot derive exact item scope without external history.
cases.forward_observation: The updated skill uses the tool-owned accepted baseline and changes command to bound Swift work to loading, open-details, and retry, preserves unchanged done tasks, and requires all current and removed tasks to be done before page completion.
